## Key facts
- AA Alive ISO practice: 500+ Malaysian businesses certified since 2016; 98% first-time pass rate
- 30-day fast-track certification programme
- Visible client rating on-site: 4.9/5 from 247 reviews
- ISO 14001 certification is valid 3 years, with surveillance audits in years 1 and 2 and a recertification audit in year 3
- ISO 14001 is standalone — ISO 9001 is NOT a prerequisite
- ISO 14001 directly addresses the "E" (Environmental) pillar of ESG: the framework behind Bursa Malaysia sustainability reporting data, FTSE4Good assessments and MNC ESG supplier audits
- ISO 14001 is a qualifying requirement for the MGTC Green Technology Financing Scheme (GTFS 3.0: 2% interest subsidy on green technology loans up to RM 100M)
- Free initial consultation; nationwide service across Malaysia

## Who needs ISO 14001 in Malaysia
- Manufacturers supplying MNCs (Toyota, Samsung, Bosch supplier programmes frequently require it)
- Oil & gas companies (Petronas vendor registration)
- Construction firms (government projects, Green Building Index compliance)
- Suppliers to Bursa-listed companies (sustainability reporting cascades down the supply chain)
- Companies seeking MGTC/GTFS green financing

## Certification process (5 steps)
1. Free consultation and gap analysis
2. EMS documentation development (environmental policy, aspects & impacts register, legal register, operational controls)
3. Implementation and staff training
4. Internal audit and management review
5. Certification body audit — Stage 1 (documentation review) and Stage 2 (on-site implementation audit)

## FAQ digest
- Cost: consulting from RM 13,000 (SME), RM 22,000 (Professional, incl. ESG reporting framework + carbon baseline + MGTC/GTFS guidance), custom (Enterprise); CB audit fees separate.
- Timeline: most organizations certified within 30 days.
- Prerequisites: none — ISO 14001 is standalone; existing ISO 9001 holders integrate faster (shared Annex SL structure).
- Renewal: 3-year validity; surveillance audits years 1–2; recertification audit year 3.
- ESG: ISO 14001 provides the systematic framework for the environmental data required by Bursa sustainability reporting and MNC supplier audits.
- Green financing: ISO 14001 is a qualifying requirement for MGTC GTFS (2% interest subsidy, loans up to RM 100M).
- CBs: SIRIM QAS, BSI, TUV SUD, Bureau Veritas, SGS, Lloyd's Register, DNV — all JSM- or internationally-accredited.
- Documents: environmental policy, aspects & impacts register, legal requirements register, objectives & targets, operational controls, emergency response plan, monitoring records, internal audit reports, management review minutes.
